authority.grammar: Presence, cleanliness, and recovery decisions are independently justified by pinned-spec acceptance audit and the public parse_rule/report contract.
authority.diagnostic_detail: Exact codes and raw coordinates are statically derived public diagnostic behavior at the stated source basis, including context remapping and token inference. They are not numeric choices mandated by CSS specifications. Treat them as API-contract characterization; do not claim an independently normative conformance oracle for the numeric fields.
authority.exact: Exact covers complete ordered sequence of error code/action/error byte offset/recovery byte span, not all Error payload fields. No unspecified values are converted to empty or zero.

shared_contract_evidence: fragments.rs:535 documents whole original input, immutable namespace context, local retention, provisional closure suppression; :581-597 publishes only one rejection diagnostic after outer failure.
fragments.rs:27 constructs complete original-source recovery span. report.rs:118 allows end-position and zero-width diagnostic provenance; :26 orders diagnostics by error byte offset.
recovery.rs:30 appends independent unterminated-comment recovery; supplied independent audit establishes no original input has one. All 66 outer failures therefore have exactly one diagnostic.

error.rs:1019 resolve_source handles next-token and previous-token inference and at-keyword remapping; :1160 rule errors remap semicolon-terminated block-required cases. The requires-block set still excludes supports and layer.

font_face.rs:60-83 iterates descriptor units and retains ident-led malformed declarations locally. mod.rs:1594 recognizes their initial Ident; block_item_diagnostic uses unit_end minus failed_unit length. Neither font-face malformed original is an outer rejection.

queries.rs:98-193 recovers one media list member as Never and preserves member_start/member_end; :567 resets failed keyword probes, preserving trivia in spans; :633 identifies unsupported operand token origin.

mod.rs:2710 and :2802 select import clauses using detached probes and replay recovery only for the selected candidate. Invalid trailing string uses no optional clauses, at the original target-end cursor 14; recovery spans 14..21 and identifies string byte 15.
recovery.rs:413 creates UnexpectedEnd at EOF with zero-width EOF span for retained implicit block closures.

cssparser-0.37.0 parser.rs expect macro saves pre-token location, next skips whitespace, and stop-before delimiters report bounded EOF; rules_and_declarations.rs:424/455 implement single-rule and missing-block handling.
